name: D1500 2x3
notes: 1500 Nm peak torque and 285 kW peak power at 1800 rpm; 2500 rpm max; mass "about 40 kg". No continuous rating published (the user notes 285 kW is a 30 s rating). 2x3 = two three-phase winding sets (redundancy), not two stacks. Peak only: compared with the fit through the peak/continuous torque ratio, not fitted.

name: D1500 1x3
notes: "1450 Nm maximum torque, 150 kW power, 2500 rpm maximum speed with a mass of 35 kg"; whether 150 kW is continuous is not stated. One three-phase winding set. Peak only, not fitted.

name: D250
notes: High-performance variant: 230 Nm peak, 208 Nm continuous, 230 kW peak; continuous power "90% peak power" (207 kW, derived). Max speed not given. Evolito stacks D250 and D500 units into one propulsion unit (same source; D500 stacking also https://evtol.news/news/evolitos-breakthrough-axial-motors).

name: E800
notes: "Rated Torque: 800 Nm", "Continuous Power: 110 kW @ 2,000RPM", "Transient Speed: 3,000 RPM", "28.3 kg complete dry LRU including prop bearing"; engines "come with integrated software and hardware" (inverter included). Rated torque and continuous power are not quoted at the same speed; base speed taken as P/T. Integrated: compared with the fit plus the inverter term, not fitted.

name: SPX242 demonstrator
notes: Direct-drive aerospace demonstrator. No inverter listed in the mass.

name: SPX242-50
notes: SPX242 family on one 242 mm lamination; suffix = stack (stator) length in mm. No inverter listed in the mass.

name: SPX242-94
notes: Stack length 94 mm.

name: SPX242-175
notes: Stack length 175 mm.

name: SPX242-175D
notes: Stack length 175 mm, D variant.

name: HPDM-250
notes: Integrated motor and SiC inverter. 18.7 kg with its 6.7:1 epicyclic gearbox (9.6 kW/kg at the 180 kW tested); 12.5 kW/kg without the gearbox including the inverter, so 180 kW / 12.5 kW/kg = 14.4 kg (derived). 200 kW continuous, 250 kW for 30 s, 20,000 rpm and 95 Nm continuous from https://sustainableskies.org/h3x-motor-high-power-density/ (earlier 15 kg prototype). Integrated: compared with the fit plus the inverter term, not fitted.

name: magni350 EPU (2021)
notes: "Total EPU weight (dry, including all magniDrives and HV DC cables): 128 kg"; 350 kW at 2300 rpm; 1608 Nm peak; 1900-2300 rpm. Stator external to the rotor (radial). Peak only, not fitted.

name: magni650 EPU (2021)
notes: Including magniDrives and HV DC cables; 700 kW at 2300 rpm; 3216 Nm peak. The Tier 13 TorqueDensityMassModel default (15 Nm/kg peak) is calibrated on these two rows. Peak only, not fitted.

name: magni350
notes: Current page: 350 kW peak and 165 kW continuous at 2300 rpm; 92.3 kg dry. Torques derived as power / 2300 rpm.

name: magni650
notes: Current page: 700 kW peak and 515 kW continuous at 2300 rpm; 144 kg dry. Torques derived as power / 2300 rpm.

name: magniAIR
notes: Air-cooled; 175 kW peak and 130 kW continuous at 2700 rpm; 43 kg dry. Torques derived as power / 2700 rpm.

name: SP260D
notes: 260 kW at 2500 rpm, 1000 Nm, 50 kg (5.2 kW/kg); continuous output "about 260 kilowatts" per https://press.siemens.com/global/en/feature/electric-flight. Whether the drive is inside the 50 kg is not stated.

name: SP200D
notes: "nominal torque of about 1,500 Nm with a weight of less than 50 kg" (30 Nm/kg). 204 kW continuous and 1300 rpm from the abstract of https://www.researchgate.net/publication/329150979_TELOS_I-_Project (page itself not retrievable); consistent with 1500 Nm at 1300 rpm.

name: ENGINeUS 45
notes: "18-kilogram weight with the controller, 12 kilograms without"; 45 kW continuous, 70 kW maximum, 172 Nm, 2500 rpm. Bare mass (12 kg) used.

name: EMRAX 228 LC
notes: Continuous values are "up to"; peak power at 5500 rpm. Liquid-cooled variant. Controller sold separately.

name: EMRAX 268 LC
notes: Continuous values are "up to"; peak power at 4500 rpm. Liquid-cooled variant. Controller sold separately.

name: EMRAX 348 LC
notes: Continuous values are "up to"; peak power at 4000 rpm. Liquid-cooled variant. Controller sold separately.
